answer: Each newcomer posts a refundable bond and must grow a unique orchard of dated work receipts from counterparties that do not overlap. Random jurors then trace those receipts through a karst of independently sampled audit paths the applicant cannot pre-select. If two identities share timing or reused proofs, both bonds are slashed, and neither crosses the admission horizon. A farm has to fund and risk a separate bond for every alias, so one honest identity stays cheaper than a swarm of fakes.
